title.zh: 数列、求和、渐近分析与递推关系

lead.en: Count what an algorithm does, prove how the count grows, and solve recursive cost models. Keep exact operations, asymptotic bounds, measured time, worst case, and amortised cost distinct.
lead.zh: 计算算法操作数，证明其增长，并求解递归成本模型。区分精确操作、渐近界、测量时间、最坏情况与摊还成本。

prerequisites.en: Modules 01 and 04: indexed finite sums, logarithms, induction, and termination. Counting from Module 05 helps with an optional polynomial–exponential comparison, but is not needed for the core route.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 01 与 04：有限求和、对数、归纳与终止。模块 05 的计数帮助理解可选多项式与指数比较，不是核心路线先修。

en: Derive arithmetic, geometric, and telescoping finite sums with boundary cases.
Prove Big O, Omega, Theta, and little o statements using their quantified definitions.
State a cost model and derive rectangular, triangular, and doubling-loop counts.
Solve equal-subproblem recurrences by expansion and verify a result by induction.
Check Master-theorem conditions and distinguish amortised from worst-case and average costs.
zh: 带边界推导等差、等比与望远镜有限和。
按量化定义证明 O、Omega、Theta 与小 o。
声明成本模型并推导矩形、三角与倍增循环计数。
展开等子问题递推并用归纳核对结果。
检查主定理条件并区分摊还、最坏与平均成本。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2; expand sums and compare the growth table.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，展开求和并比较增长表。

text.en: Predict the three loop counts, then run their traces.
text.zh: 预测三种循环计数再运行跟踪。

text.en: Retrieve finite-sum rules and distinguish counts from seconds.
text.zh: 回忆有限和规则，区分计数与秒。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and write explicit bound witnesses.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并写明确界见证。

text.en: Read asymptotic definitions and the cost-model selection.
text.zh: 阅读渐近定义与成本模型选段。

text.en: State the quantifier order in Big O and little o.
text.zh: 写 O 与小 o 的量词顺序。

text.en: Read Section 5; derive the recursion-tree level costs.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节，推导递归树层成本。

text.en: Run recurrence counts and compare exact solutions.
text.zh: 运行递推计数并比较精确解。

text.en: Read recurrence expansion and check the base condition.
text.zh: 阅读递推展开并检查基础条件。

text.en: Read Section 6 and use the recurrence explorer.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节并使用递推探索器。

text.en: Diagnose timing scope, borderline recurrence, and append costs.
text.zh: 诊断计时范围、边界递推与追加成本。

text.en: Complete the choices and written bound argument.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面界论证。

text.en: Read amortised analysis and identify the charged operations.
text.zh: 阅读摊还分析并明确收费操作。

text.en: Complete the exit task and graph-analysis readiness check.
text.zh: 完成结业任务与图分析准备。
